_comment: Side-step maneuver demo: zoom in on the lone Spearmen (seed 12345; uid0 stands at x=452/y=300 under Battle._spawn_line's current spacing, facing south toward the enemy), select it, then right-click a short step to the right. The click target (480, 300) is a ~28-unit shift, comfortably under UnitManeuver.SIDESTEP_MAX_DISTANCE (40.0), so the regiment SIDE-STEPS -- it shuffles right at a walk while holding its south-facing line, instead of centre-pivoting to face the move and pivoting back. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd. World coordinates; physics ticks (60/s). The select click MUST land on the unit's actual spawn position: an earlier revision clicked (407, 300), a stale coordinate from a previous spawn layout, so the click selected nothing, the regiment never moved, and both expectations below failed silently on every run -- including the website's own sidestep clip, which reads this same script via website/tools/demo-catalog.sh.
